# Synthetic voice fixture

`synthetic-voice.ogg` is an AI-generated, mono Opus recording created for this project on 14 September 2026 with OpenAI `tts-1`, voice `nova`, speed 1.1. It contains no personal data:

“Schedule Judo pickup on September ninth, two thousand twenty-seven, at four in the afternoon.”

Offline tests use it for media validation, transcription transport mocks, and encrypted WhatsApp upload/retry checks. They make no external API requests.
